disclosures.text: Cleaning device for curved profile surfaces
Surfaces are curved transverse to the direction of progress
At least two cantilever arms
A cleaning head is at the free end of each arm
Cleaning head has a curved contour in the direction of progress
Cleaning device with at least one cantilever arm
Cleaning head has multiple rotating brushes
Cleaning head has three rotating brushes
Brush rotation axes are parallel to the tangential direction of the surface
Brush rotation axes are inclined relative to each other
Brushes overlap each other in their direction of travel
Bristle length is at least 12% of the distance from the trough bottom to the central tube
Bristle length is at least 25% of the distance from the trough bottom to the central tube
Bristle length is at least 30% of the distance from the trough bottom to the central tube
Method for cleaning curved surfaces using rotating brushes

Cleaning device with at least two cantilever arms, each with a cleaning head at its free end, where the cleaning head has a curved contour in the direction of progress, for cleaning curved profile surfaces transverse to the direction of pro

Cleaning device for curved profile surfaces with at least one cantilever arm and a cleaning head at its free end, where the cleaning head comprises multiple rotating brushes whose rotation axes are parallel to the tangential direction of th
Method for cleaning curved surfaces using rotating brushes, where the surfaces are curved transverse to the direction of progress
Cantilever arm is telescopic
Cantilever arm consists of two or three articulated arm parts
Arm parts are telescopically extendable in their longitudinal direction
Actuating cylinder near the joint adjusts the angular position between arm parts
Actuating cylinder is on the outside of the arm parts
Cleaning head's inclination is adjustable at the free end of the arm
Cleaning head is pivotable by 180° around the longitudinal axis of the arm
Intermediate angle between rotation axes is adjustable
Middle brush is fixed or articulated to the cantilever arm
Middle brush's angular position is automatically adjustable during operation
Other two brushes are adjustably fixed to the middle brush's holder
Other two brushes are cantilevered on one side
Each brush is driven by its own hydraulic motor
Hydraulic motors are connected in series
Base body of at least one outer brush is pivotable on a cantilever arm
Base body is pivotable by a hydraulic cylinder
Pivoting occurs in the axis plane defined by the brush rotation axes
Cantilever arm is part of a parallelogram with four articulated struts
Two hinge points of one short side of the parallelogram are rotatably attached to the middle brush's holder
Opposite short side of the parallelogram is formed by the extended base body of the outer brush
Cantilever arm is pivotable by a hydraulic cylinder supported by the middle brush's frame
Spray bar is upstream of the brushes in the direction of progress
Spray bar extends across the entire width of the cleaning head
Spray bar has multiple outlet openings for cleaning fluid
Outlet openings spray cleaning fluid onto rotating bristles when behind brushes
Outlet openings spray cleaning fluid onto the surface when in front of brushes
Cantilever arm is attached at the outer edge of the trough or in the center of the cleaning head
Cleaning head has only a single brush
Rotating brush has a convex contour adapted to the surface
Central body of the brush consists of two parts connected by a universal joint
Ends of the brush parts are connected by a U-shaped support frame
Brush ends are adjustable in distance via an actuating cylinder in the bracket
Cleaning head includes a squeegee lip behind the brushes
Squeegee lip removes cleaning fluid from the surface
Squeegee lip is oblique to the direction of progress
Upper end of the squeegee lip is further forward than the lower end
Brush rotation axes are oblique to the direction of progress
Upper ends of brush axes are further forward in the direction of progress than lower ends
Cleaning head has a cleaning device for the central tube
Spray bar has an outlet opening directed at the central tube
Central body of the brush is convex in side view
Bristle trim is a spirally wound flexible bristle support plate
Bristle support plate is wound and fixed to the central body
Bristle support plate is screwed to the central body
Brushes are cylindrical with constant bristle length along their length
Brushes have varying bristle lengths along their length
Cleaning head includes a central body curved according to the surface contour
Cup brushes are offset along the curved central body
Cup brushes have rotation axes perpendicular to the cleaning surface
Cup brush rotation direction at the front edge is towards the lower edge of the surface
Each cleaning head has at least one spaced sensor
Each cleaning head has two spaced sensors in the transverse direction
Sensors are non-contact (optical, ultrasonic, or radar)
Sensors detect a prominent longitudinal contour
Sensors detect the outer edges of the surface
Cleaning device base has at least one sensor on each side
Base sensor detects the distance from the edge of the surface
Each cleaning head has a pre-cleaning unit for rough cleaning
Pre-cleaning unit has compressed air outlets
Pre-cleaning unit has suction air inlets
Pre-cleaning unit has vibrators (ultrasonic vibrators)
Suction air inlets have compressed air ejectors as a suction air source
Lower cleaning head has a collection device for cleaning fluid
Collection device includes a collection channel
Collection channel includes a vacuum connection
Cleaning device has a reprocessing plant for dirty washing liquid
Reprocessing plant includes a dirt filter
Reprocessing plant includes an intermediate tank for dirty cleaning liquid
Cleaning device includes a control unit
Control unit automatically controls arm telescoping and inclination
Control unit automatically controls cleaning head inclination
Control unit automatically controls cleaning head distance from surface based on sensor signals
Cleaning device has an E-field generator
Each cleaning head has an E-field generator
E-field generator produces an electric field of at least 50 V/m
E-field generator produces an electric field of at least 200 V/m
E-field generator reduces surface tension of cleaning fluid
E-field generator includes at least one Tesla coil
E-field generator includes a radiator electrically connected to the Tesla coil's hot end
Radiator is a spherical radiator
E-field generator is near the cleaning fluid supply lines to the cleaning heads
Cleaning fluid supply line passes through the eye of the Tesla coil
Cleaning device includes a cleaning vehicle
Front working cantilever arm is in front of the vehicle
Front working cantilever arm is long
Rear working cantilever arm is behind the driver's cab
Rear working cantilever arm is shorter
Rear working cantilever arm is at the rear of the vehicle
Vehicle has a suspension locking device effective on at least one side
Suspension locking device is a lockable torsional auxiliary frame
Suspension locking device is a lockable vertical axle support on the unsteered axle
Vehicle includes a camera directed at the rear cleaning head
Vehicle includes a monitor in the driver's cab connected to the camera
